about: Budget profiles for ONE model file treated as a whole scene. When a scene holds several models, share the budget between them. Every number is a working value chosen for mstack and none was read from a primary source in this work: measure on the target device or re-source the limit before blocking a release on it.

triangles.source: mstack working value, no primary source
triangles.note: working value; Meta's Unity performance page (https://developers.meta.com/horizon/documentation/unity/unity-perf/) gives only example ranges (Quest 2/Pro: 80-200 draw calls in busy scenes, 750k-1m triangles; Quest 3/3S: 200-300 and 1.3m-1.8m); no source fixes a number for WebXR
